items.body_raw: וְלָאָרֶץ לֹא יְכֻפַּר לַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּהּ כִּי אִם בְּדַם שֹׁפְכוֹ
items.answer_raw: And no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that has been shed in it, except by the blood of him that shed it.

items.body_raw: וְהָלְכוּ יוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כַּעִוְרִים וְשֻׁפַּךְ דָּמָם כֶּעָפָר
items.answer_raw: And the inhabitants of the land shall go (i.e. walk) like blind men, and their blood shall be poured out like dust.
